DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM

Data Processing Addendum to the Master Service Agreement between Harborview
Health Systems and Trellis Data Partners, Inc. dated 3 March 2026.

This Data Processing Addendum ("DPA") is entered into as of 24 March 2026
between Harborview Health Systems ("Covered Entity") and Trellis Data
Partners, Inc. ("Business Associate") in connection with Business
Associate's processing of Protected Health Information (PHI) on behalf of
Covered Entity under the Master Service Agreement referenced above.

1. PROCESSING PURPOSES. Business Associate shall process PHI solely to
perform the Services described in active Statements of Work issued under
the Master Service Agreement, including Statement of Work SOW-001.

2. SUBPROCESSORS. Business Associate's current subprocessors are: (a)
Northgate Cloud Infrastructure, Inc. (cloud hosting); and (b) Vireo
Analytics Platform Services, LLC (analytics infrastructure). Business
Associate shall provide Covered Entity not less than thirty (30) days'
advance written notice before engaging any new subprocessor.

3. SECURITY INCIDENT NOTIFICATION. Business Associate shall notify Covered
Entity within twenty-four (24) hours of discovering any security incident
involving unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, PHI.

4. RETURN OR DESTRUCTION OF DATA. Upon termination or expiration of the
Master Service Agreement, Business Associate shall return or destroy all
PHI within sixty (60) days and provide written certification of such
return or destruction.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this DPA as of the date first
written above.

For HARBORVIEW HEALTH SYSTEMS             For TRELLIS DATA PARTNERS, INC.
Name: L. Fennimore                         Name: K. Ostrander
Title: VP Strategic Partnerships           Title: Chief Revenue Officer
